_comment: Frozen-carrier value data (docs/FEATURE_FAMILIES.md, profiles/v_pilot.json). One arm, the frozen carrier v12_ponly_xxl (policy XXL from inference/models_xxl, V off, fixed-time search), plays the frozen reference roster on fresh maps; keep_matches saves every match so training.dataset --rows designated can take the carrier's own rows. Data seed 20261201 is for training data only (never reuse 20261009, 20261020, 20261031, 20261101, 20261102, 20261107 or 20261108; screens of this work use 20261210 and 20261211; the confirmation seed stays unchosen until finalists are frozen). The report is a by-product, not a comparison.
